messages:
Morgan: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: lander refactor for kernel slotting, added metrics for microbatch occupancy. Blockers: seeing ~3-4% tail latency increase in 512-token traces when prefetch is enabled. Today: bisect the change, add more detailed histograms, and run the full microburst suite.

Alex: saw the same tail bump in last night's nightly run. I repro'd locally with small harness. Output snippet:
```
$ ./bench/microbatch --model res-8g --seq 512 --iters 200
mean=12.3ms p95=23.4ms p99=38.7ms (prefetch=on)
mean=11.8ms p95=22.0ms p99=33.2ms (prefetch=off)
```
Noted a spike correlated with background compaction on the KV cache host.

Priya: ran KV eviction heatmap — hotspot on shard-3, eviction rate jumped after the refactor. I pushed a small patch to throttle compaction during warmup. PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4821 — please review. Blocker for me is needing a green non-flaky microburst before I promote.

Sam: can we schedule a short canary for the patch? I can run a dedicated small pool (4xA100) for 30m tonight. Recommend we include both prefetch on/off runs and a KV-saturated workload.

Jae: pinging for reviews: I have two tiny kernel changes (slot allocator + metrics rename). Reviews needed: @Alex @Morgan. Also noticed the bench harness defaults to batch_size=8 now — is that intended? Might affect comparisons.

Morgan: @Jae good catch — batch_size=8 is intentional for the new flow but we should keep an explicit flag in the CI harness so historical runs are comparable. I'll add that today.

Alex: I'll look at Jae's PRs and Priya's throttling patch after standup. For the compaction correlation I'm going to add a simple log marker at compaction start/end so we can align traces.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #build-2023-microburst passed (all tests) :white_check_mark:
https://ci.redwood/builds/2023-microburst/4821

Priya: quick question — Sam, can you also capture KV metrics (evictions/sec, avg-ttl) during the canary? That will help verify throttling effects.

Sam: yes — I'll wire the perf agent to scrape those counters and include the heatmap. Will post results here after run.

Morgan: blocker summary for today: repro tail, add compaction logs, make CI harness batch flag explicit. If anyone is blocked on reviews ping in PR thread and I'll prioritize.

Jae: done — bumped both PRs with fixes, added a note about batch flag in the bench README.

Alex: starting review now. If I see anything risky I'll request a tiny revert-ready change instead of a big rework.

Priya: thanks. If the canary looks good, I'll promote the throttling to canary lanes.

Sam: scheduled canary for 23:30 PT, will post artifact link + heatmap.

Morgan: perfect. small follow-ups: 1) add p99.9 to microburst reporting, 2) annotate traces with compaction markers, 3) ensure bench runs include both prefetch states. I'll update the checklist in the PR. :thumbsup:

Alex: +1

Jae: thanks, all.
